new_levers.verdict: a strict improvement in concentration (16 -> 11 alone, 6 with the other levers) but not a landing: the two remaining atoms (173,114 B return-bearing shell; ~86 KB async body) are bigger than a window's 25 % allowance, and MOVING an atom does not help — only splitting it does

new_levers.what: a shell refused for `returns` is lifted as a LABELLED BLOCK instead: `!function(p){A;if(x)return;B;return v;C}(arg)` -> `L:{var p=arg;A;if(x)break L;B;(v);break L;C}`. Legal because the dissolve pass only rewrites ExpressionStatement roots, so the shell's value is discarded by construction; `return v` becomes `(v);break L` (v still evaluated for its effects), and the label encloses the whole body so every break lands where its return did. Implemented as a text-edit splice in the emitter (registerEdit/slicePush) over the return's own span.

new_levers.what: generalized RUN_EXPORT: a run of consecutive statements is replaced by a helper CALL, the statements go inside a hoisted helper declaration in the same body. A function declaration is what the deal already scatters, so the run's bytes leave the window; the call is ~10 B at the run's position. Per-statement + per-run eligibility: no own-level return / this / arguments / super / new.target; no bound name referenced outside the run's span; slice-safe only (no synthetic text, no text edit, textually adjacent to the previous member); material the deal can already place is left alone.

remaining_mechanism.requirement: arithmetic: no contiguous piece from one bucket may exceed ~56 KB, and pieces must be separated by other buckets' material
remaining_mechanism.mechanism: run-wrap splitting of large function bodies: wrap a run of consecutive statements in a helper declared at the same scope and call it at exactly the run's position (async + await when the run contains await)
legality: no return/break/continue transferring out of the run
no name the run declares (var/let/const/function/class) used after the run — a helper's declarations do not escape it
no this/arguments/new.target at the run's own level
remaining_mechanism.why_it_is_the_last_one: it is the only rule that turns a 126 KB flow into placeable 10-40 KB declarations; purity is NOT required because the call site preserves evaluation order
